structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身就是高度几何化、符号化的 Logo（字母 K + 圆圈 + 音符），符合 theme_rules 中 'preserve_when' 的条件（清晰的几何符号）。参考 Bilibili 和 Douyin 的案例，应保留其拓扑结构和空间布局，仅对填充材质、描边风格和色彩映射进行主题化重构，无需重组语义。
preserve: 中心 'K' 字的左右两部分相对位置及形态
外圈圆弧的大致走向和缺口位置
音符位于左上角的空间关系
must_preserve: 左上角悬浮的八分音符
recompose_allowed: 线条边缘平滑度转化为不规则抖动
原始品牌橙色映射为主题砖红或奶黄
原始品牌蓝色映射为主题深蓝
图形填充质感转化为哑光平涂/蜡笔纹理
restyle: 将平滑矢量边缘替换为粗犷马克笔/蜡笔笔触
去除所有立体光影、高光和渐变
采用扁平化色块拼接风格
forbid: 保留原始的亮黄色背景
使用平滑锐利的矢量边缘
添加立体阴影、高光或环境光遮蔽
改变 'K' 字的基本笔画拓扑结构
移除外部的圆环或音符元素
使用主题色板（红/蓝/黄/白/黑）之外的颜色
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle style Kuwo Music icon on pure black background. Centered abstract 'K' letter shape in brick-red or creamy-yellow flat color, surrounded by a rough incomplete circular outline. A dark blue eighth note floats at the top-left. Thick, shaky, uneven black marker strokes defining all shapes. Crayon/wax texture, no gradients, no shadows, naive and clumsy aesthetic.
color_application: Map original orange brand color to theme's brick-red or creamy-yellow; map original blue accent to theme's deep blue. Use solid flat fills only, strictly avoiding gradients or original bright yellow background.
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines to the 'K', circle, and note. Edges must appear shaky and rough, simulating a dry marker or crayon on paper, rejecting smooth vector lines.
composition_application: Center the simplified 'K' + Circle + Note composition. Maintain the relative spatial arrangement (Note top-left, K center, Circle surrounding). Subject occupies 60-70% of the canvas against the pure black void.
identity_application: Retain the specific geometric skeleton of the stylized 'K' and the positional relationship of the note and circle to ensure immediate brand recognition, while fully adopting the retro doodle visual language.
fidelity_constraints: Must apply thick, shaky, hand-drawn black strokes
Colors must be limited to high-saturation brick-red, deep-blue, creamy-yellow/white
Must be completely flat with no shadows, highlights, or 3D effects
Texture must simulate dry media (crayon/marker) not glossy plastic
negative_constraints: No realistic, photorealistic, or 3D rendered elements
No gradients, glows, or lighting effects
No white or colored backgrounds other than pure black
No loss of the 'K' letter structure or the musical note symbol
